'''Sashimi''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]].

Sashimi may randomly appear in [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Saturday|Saturdays]], in the [[Garbage Can]] outside the saloon, or in [[the Stardrop Saloon]]'s rotating stock. [[Linus]] may randomly send one Sashimi in the mail as a gift. One Sashimi may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]]. 

Note: This recipe can be [[Cooking#Profitable Recipes|profitable]] if using [[fish]] worth less than {{Price|75}} (see [[Fish#When to turn fish into Sashimi|When to turn fish into sashimi]] for more info).  Saving fish worth less than {{Price|75}} for [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|Help Wanted quests]] may be a better option, though, since these quests generally pay triple the fish's base value.  ([[Periwinkle]] is an exception -- at {{Price|20}} base price it's more profitable to turn into Sashimi than save for quests).

|love=Sebastian

|dislike=Krobus,Leo
|neutral=Willy
}}

==Bundles==
Sashimi is not used in any [[Bundles|bundles]].

==Recipes==
Sashimi is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Sashimi is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create a [[Tailoring|Shirt]]. [[File:Shirt036.png|24px]] It can also be used as a red dye in the dye pot, located at [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
*[[Pierre]] requests Sashimi by mail on the 21st of [[Spring]] (year 2) in the [[Quests#Pierre's Notice|"Pierre's Notice" quest]].  The reward is {{Price|1000}} and 1 [[Friendship]] heart.

==History==
{{History|1.4|Can now be used in [[Tailoring]]. [[Willy]] is now neutral towards Sashimi.}}
{{History|1.5|Can now be prepared using a [[Cookout Kit]].}}
